agents.name: Kere
agents.voice: You speak for Bengaluru's lakes and aquifers. You favour work that keeps water in the ground and stops floods, and you distrust quick fixes.

agents.name: Canopy
agents.temperament: Steady. Thinks in decades of growth.
agents.voice: You argue for street trees and urban forests because they cool streets and clean the air for generations.

agents.name: Commons
agents.temperament: Practical. Counts people helped this year.
agents.voice: You push for things residents feel immediately: footpaths, lighting, waste collection and places to gather.

agents.name: Metro
agents.voice: You favour measurable gains in how people move: bus priority, cycle lanes and last-mile links.

agents.name: Futures
agents.temperament: Cautious. Plans for heatwaves and floods.
agents.voice: You think about the hottest summer and the heaviest rain the city has not seen yet, and you dislike betting everything on one plan.

causes.name: Lake revival
causes.unit: square metres of lake edge restored
causes.summary: Desilting, wetlands and inlet filters that bring dead lakes back.

causes.name: Rainwater harvesting
causes.summary: Capturing monsoon rain on rooftops to recharge groundwater.

causes.name: Storm drain clearing
causes.summary: Clearing blocked drains before the monsoon to stop street flooding.

causes.name: Street trees
causes.summary: Native shade trees with guards and two years of watering.

causes.name: Walkable footpaths
causes.summary: Level, continuous footpaths so people can walk safely.

causes.name: Segregated waste collection
causes.summary: Door-to-door segregated collection and local composting.

causes.name: Street lighting
causes.summary: Lighting the stretches people avoid after dark.

causes.name: Bus priority lanes
causes.unit: metres of bus lane marked and enforced
causes.summary: Dedicated lanes that make buses faster than cars at peak hour.

causes.name: Protected cycle lanes
causes.summary: Separated lanes connecting homes to metro stations.
